value.rationale: The matrix logarithm is a central real-symmetric functional-calculus transform used for covariance and network matrices. The result provides an exact, sharp entrywise robustness budget depending on both conditioning endpoints, a nontrivial linear-dimensional amplification law at fixed spectral ratio, and the natural critical n^{-1/2} spectral-width crossover with explicit polynomial profile. The upper spectral boundary is mathematically essential; the crossover cannot be deduced from the known one-sided worst-case coefficient.
